recommendation: #183 answered for the maintainer's ruling: keep the parity gates' 0000 RNG pin as their basis, record in their headers that they compare the zero random path only, and close #183

Scratch copies of tests/audit_move_parity.sh (ALL=1, 32 parts), tests/audit_chains174.sh and tests/audit_chains184.sh, differing from the committed gates only in the RNG pin line and an absolute REPO path (scratch_vs_gates.diff), were run on merged-m21 under two other RNG forms: B, 0100 poked on every frame from 2363 (a non-zero word; by the routine in engine_internals.md, a draw from 0100 returns 3), and C, 5a5a poked 2363..2599 and then free (as tests/audit_rng_draws.sh seeds). Against the frozen tests/expected/move_parity_events.tsv (526 rows, measured under 0000), form B leaves 501 rows unchanged, turns NO IDENT row DIFF, turns 10 DIFF rows IDENT (all of donovan_10 plus donovan_11:12) and changes the detail of 15 DIFF rows; form C changes 104 rows, 32 of them IDENT to DIFF and 33 DIFF to IDENT (cmp183.txt). audit_chains174 passes under B with all 28 rows as frozen; under C, eight huitzil rows move (one IDENT to DIFF) and its x-moved control reads DEAD. audit_chains184 fails under both B and C at its native outcome check (Sword Grapple [HP] with P2 jumping at +8 no longer starts a2:0x41 on native), so its rows were not compared. Each copy's in-gate controls fired except that one DEAD control (chains184 stopped before its controls). engine_internals.md records that ours draws the RNG in vsavj's motion trackers where native does not (265, 88 and 63 draws on the three tenants' chains174 rigs) and the maintainer ruled those trackers host behaviour (#176), so a free RNG is not an equalised input for an ours-vs-native gate. On that I recommend: keep the 0000 pin, add to each parity gate's NOT COVERED that it compares the zero random path only, with form B's measurement as the evidence that a non-zero per-frame pin raises no new difference on these two gates' current rows, and close #183; the alternatives are a second pinned leg at a non-zero word (twice the runtime, and audit_chains184's grab-whiff rig re-timed), or seed-then-free. NOT tested: which update order the object loop took under B, or which branches a 3 and the frame's later draws select; any other non-zero word; the other gates that pin 0000 (about 20 beyond these three); audit_chains184's rows under B or C; what caused C's 32 IDENT to DIFF rows (not attributed to the trackers or anything else); FBNeo; a second host; run-to-run repeats of B and C.
